source_snapshot.procedure: Enable Turbo Mode, save/reset, stress and verify frequency exceeds base; then disable Turbo Mode, save/reset, stress and verify frequency remains at base.
source_snapshot.criteria: Criterion 1 says Enabled exceeds base; Criterion 2 mistakenly repeats Enabled while expecting base-frequency behavior.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 30/60 minutes; unique code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL insecure malformed static metadata shortcut; does not execute both BIOS states, stress or time-series measurement.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; retains both states and requests correction of Criterion 2 plus controlled workload, measurement rules and restore.

old_problem: Criterion 2 repeats Turbo Enabled although the immediately preceding Procedure explicitly changes to Disabled. Authoritative base frequency, disabled tolerance, enabled exceedance rule, topology aggregation, workload/sampling and thermal/power validity are absent. DeepSeek samples only incomplete static metadata.
disposition_reason: The row's ordered procedure provides direct internal evidence that Criterion 2's second `Enabled` is a transcription defect and must bind to the Disabled phase; this is recorded rather than silently changed. Numeric tolerance, workload and sampling remain signed Project Configuration under ED-15, so no threshold is invented. BIOS writes/resets remain operator-gated, and both phases plus final restoration are mandatory.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2044, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2045 / Wistron-HW-00486-V002 / 15cec2f2496e6944 was directly read from XLSX.
Procedure steps 1-4 unambiguously pair Enabled with exceeding base and Disabled with keeping base; treating Criterion 2 as Disabled reconciles the local contradiction without adding a new behavior.
Actual P-state/Turbo behavior requires a bounded stress workload and time-series counters across all sockets/selected cores; lscpu limits or one snapshot do not prove it.
Turbo availability depends on active-core count, power and thermal headroom; runs invalidated by throttling cannot be converted to PASS.
ED-11 restricts BIOS changes to named settings, ED-14 prevents a short smoke sample replacing the approved duration, and ED-15 keeps numeric tolerances owner-approved.
No BIOS change/reset, OS login, stress workload, frequency/thermal collection or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Under one approved stress and sampling protocol, verify Turbo Enabled produces the approved above-base behavior and Turbo Disabled remains within the approved base-frequency envelope across the required CPU topology, then restore the final BIOS recipe.
required_package: Exact row-2044 variant plus SUT/BIOS/BMC/CPU model, stepping and socket/core topology
Approved Turbo Enabled/Disabled BIOS path, initial/final setting and console recovery
Authoritative base frequency, enabled exceedance rule and disabled-state tolerance/aggregation
Approved stress tool/workload/duration/affinity, sample cadence and frequency field/tool mapping
Power-limit/temperature/throttle validity rules, maintenance/reset authorization and secure OS access
test_case.test_command: HYBRID OPERATOR-GATED; preserve initial BIOS and logs. An authorized operator sets only Turbo Enabled, captures the screen/export, saves/resets and proves OS Ready; run the approved bounded stress with thermal/power aborts and collect untruncated time-series frequency, workload, temperature, power-limit and throttle evidence for the required topology. Repeat independently with Turbo Disabled using identical conditions. Evaluate Criterion 2 as context-corrected Disabled and retain the source defect note. Restore and verify the approved final setting with an authorized reset. Do not clear logs, use insecure SSH or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Enabled samples satisfy the owner-approved above-base rule while workload and thermal/power validity hold; Disabled samples remain within the approved base envelope. Both phases cover the required sockets/cores, boot cleanly without new faults, and the final Turbo setting matches the approved recipe.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both Enabled and Disabled phases, approved numeric rules/workload/duration/aggregation, complete time-series and validity evidence, and verified restoration. FAIL on wrong setting, missing topology/sample, Enabled not meeting exceedance, Disabled outside base tolerance, invalid throttling/power/thermal condition, boot fault or failed restore. Missing threshold/package/approval is NOT READY, not PASS.
safety_gate: Only named Turbo Enabled/Disabled changes are allowed under human authorization; no random/all BIOS modification.
Bound stress by approved duration with temperature, power and throttle abort conditions.
Stop on failed boot, topology mismatch, abnormal frequency, overtemperature or invalid throttling; preserve evidence.
No log clearing, plaintext credentials, automatic BIOS toggle or workload retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and explicit Criterion-2 transcription reconciliation
CPU topology, approved BIOS/workload/measurement recipe and signed base/exceedance/tolerance rules
Per-phase BIOS visual/export and save/reset/OS-ready evidence
Complete Enabled and Disabled workload plus time-series frequency/thermal/power/throttle outputs
Per-topology aggregation and validity analysis with unexpected-log review
Final restored BIOS evidence, no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On failed boot, invalid setting, thermal/power abort or frequency anomaly, stop workload and preserve console/BIOS/OS logs. Use approved console recovery to restore the recorded final Turbo value; do not retry or alter unrelated settings. Escalate if OS Ready or restoration cannot be proven.

source_conflict.reason: The ordered Procedure is authoritative local evidence that Criterion 2 belongs to Disabled; signed numeric and workload rules close the remaining measurement gaps without invented thresholds.

blocked.reason: The two-state method, verdict and recovery are complete; platform measurement rules and approvals are runtime Project Configuration.
